evidence.quote: The language of instruction is English for the first year. Classes take place in German from the third semester onward.
The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 1,500 EUR
International degree-seeking students from non-EU countries pay the full semester contribution + tuition fees each semester.
Next intake for winter semester 2027/28 Application portal will open 15 April 2027
Recommended application timeline 15 May latest for international applicants (for visa reasons)
Apply online via our application portal: https://campus.th-mannheim.de

name.fr: Certificats de fin d'études secondaires avec notes
Formulaire d'information sur les frais de scolarité

evidence.quote: Required application documents School leaving certificates with grades and university transcripts of your current course of studies (if you are studying already) -- Upload one combined pdf scan max. size 5 MB. English language proof (IELTS, TOEFL, OTE) CV (written in English and up-to-date) Letter of reference (written in English) from one of your teachers or professors, preferably in Maths or Physics Motivational letter (written in English, maximum one A4 page)
„Auskunftsformular“ on tuition fees (= information form for assessing whether the obligation to pay tuition fees for international students applies)
English language skills needed Proof of sufficient English language skills is one of the admission prerequisites (TOEFL minimum 88 (IBT) or 4.5; IELTS minimum 6.5; OTE minimum 130).

note.fr: Un comité d'admission examine vos notes en maths et en physique ; obtenez de très bonnes notes dans ces matières.
note.en: An admissions committee reviews your grades in Maths and Physics; aim for a very good school-leaving certificate.

evidence.quote: Our admissions committee focuses on your grades in Maths and Physics.

notes: Tuition fees: EUR 1,500 per semester applies to non-EU degree-seeking students. Deadline: 31 July 2027 is the general application deadline; 15 May 2027 is recommended (not required) for international applicants for visa reasons. Application channel: the pages only describe the university's own portal (campus.th-mannheim.de) and email evaluation; no uni-assist or VPD is mentioned.
